payload.body: You tend to share the bold idea, watch the reaction, and then stop answering messages or abandon the project. Other people see your difference in short bursts instead of getting to know it over time. Underneath is often the expectation that being unusual will attract judgment, pressure, or attempts to change you. Stay long enough for one difference to become ordinary.
payload.astroHint: Lilith opposite Uranus can make you alternate between being conspicuously different and disappearing from view.
